description.en: Generic geological process/form analog: branching drainage dissection of bare erodible sedimentary terrain. Informed by NPS field photograph and arid erosion explanation, not named-site DEM, exact Badlands terrain, stratigraphic age or coexisting ecosystem. Nominal260x300x75m terrain module illustrative. No uniform layer stripes or freestanding hoodoo replacement. Ridges are remaining divides, channels cut down a regional slope.
